title: DNS resolution layers and outcomes
summary: Separate application lookup, local resolver, recursive resolution and authoritative DNS outcomes.

concepts.title: Execution context
concepts.explanation: Applications may use OS resolver libraries, custom resolvers, proxies or container-specific configuration.

concepts.title: Response outcomes
concepts.explanation: NXDOMAIN, SERVFAIL, timeout, refusal and an empty or wrong answer represent different evidence.

concepts.title: Authority path
concepts.explanation: Recursive resolution follows delegation toward authoritative data and can fail at several layers.

limitations: A successful lookup from one host does not prove the application execution context can resolve the name.
Switching resolvers can mask rather than correct an authoritative or local-policy problem.
